body.name: observed-law mixture information modulus
body.construction: For each budget \(\gamma\) and testing radius \(\eta\), \(\Omega_{\mathcal D,\gamma}(\eta)\) is the largest uniform separation in \(\tau_W\) between two priors supported on \(\mathcal Y_{M,\gamma}\) whose assignment-averaged observed-data mixture laws have total variation at most \(\eta\), as specified in the symbol table.
